about_the_game:
Ready for your shift?

Step into the role of a doctor in a chaotic emergency room, where every second can mean the difference between life and death. Explore a richly detailed hospital environment with authentic medical equipment, from first response in the trauma bay to bedside patient care.

From Symptom to Diagnosis

Visual exams, CT scans, X-rays, ultrasounds, ECGs, blood tests - run the right tests to confirm your suspicions. Listen to the paramedic's briefing, question and examine your patients, and ask the right questions.

Find the Right Treatment

Treat your patients with the right tools: administer medication, stitch up wounds, or apply bandages. Every treatment follows real medical procedures.

Every Second Counts

When things get serious, every second counts. Master time-critical emergencies like CPR and save lives when there's no time to hesitate.

Features

  • Medical Detective Work: Examine patients, ask targeted questions, run diagnostic tests, and log your findings in the patient chart

  • You're the Doctor: Diagnose and treat your patients independently

  • Your Choices Matter: Prioritize diagnoses at your own discretion and decide which path to take first

  • Save Lives Under Pressure: Perform time-critical emergency treatments where every second counts

  • Realistic Treatment Procedures: Treat wounds, administer medication, and handle injuries using real medical procedures

  • Authentic ER Setting: Move through a detailed, immersive hospital environment with realistic medical equipment

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Experience a balanced mix of quiet moments and sudden, high-stakes emergencies
